root_idea.summary: The root centers on bringing things into sound relation and repair: sewing joins and mends, while counsel seeks another's good and sincerity excludes deceit.
root_idea.development: The lexical development extends from sewing, thread, and mending to sincere counsel, pure or genuine things, well-mended states, and related ideas of satisfying or making complete.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed under its singular active-participle citation form.
Displayed as the verbal noun نُصْحٌ.
Displayed under the adjective citation form نَصُوحٌ.

senses.definition: To advise or counsel sincerely; to seek another's good and direct that person toward it, whether by speech or sincere action.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction نَصَحَ لَهُ is the established and more chaste construction; the direct-object construction نَصَحَهُ is also attested but was regarded as less usual. The Quranic forms express advising, well-wishing, and sincere conduct.

senses.definition: A sincere adviser or counsellor; one who seeks and promotes another's good, or acts toward another with sincerity and goodwill.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences use the active participle for advisers, sincere well-wishers, and those characterized by sincere conduct. Number and definiteness vary by context.

senses.definition: Sincere advice or counsel, including sincere conduct and the intention to secure what is good for the person addressed.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence it appears in the possessive expression نُصْحِي, “my sincere advice.” The noun can encompass both the counsel expressed in words and the sincerity of the conduct behind it.

senses.definition: Thoroughly sincere, genuine, and sound; in تَوْبَةٌ نَصُوحٌ, repentance that is genuine and steadfast rather than a return to the abandoned sin.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic adjective characterizes repentance. The explanation can emphasize either sincerity or the thorough mending and completion of repentance; the form is also discussed alongside the variant verbal-noun reading نُصُوحًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become pure, unadulterated, or genuine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical use describing the thing itself rather than advice or counsel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sew a garment or shirt, especially to sew it well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sewing use, marked as figurative in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drink until satisfied; of camels, to drink in earnest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or of camels in descriptions of complete or abundant drinking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of rain, to water a district abundantly so that its herbage becomes dense and closely joined.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension describing the completed effect of abundant rain on the land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clarify honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported but disputed Classical usage; the same lexical discussion records its rejection by another authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To advise or counsel one another sincerely and faithfully.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III expresses reciprocal or mutual advising.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To water camels so as to satisfy them with drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV has the specialized watering-camels use in the Classical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be lavish or prodigal in giving sincere advice or counsel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form describes an excessive amount of advising, with the associated conventional warning that this may arouse suspicion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect to be like sincere advisers or to pose as one of them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a separate Form V use describing assumed or imitated advising.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To advise or counsel one another sincerely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI marks mutual participation in the act of counselling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accept sincere advice or counsel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use meaning to receive and accept advice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a person as a sincere adviser or counsellor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use distinct from accepting advice itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To regard or deem someone a sincere, faithful, or honest adviser or counsellor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X expresses judging or recognizing a person as possessing the quality of a نَصِيح.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thread used for sewing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun has a plural form نُصُحٌ or نِصَاحَةٌ in the cited lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Skins, in a Classical plural usage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning is reported in the interpretation of a cited poetic expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Snares or cords fitted with loops, set for catching apes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural noun; the lexical evidence records variant explanations of the cited poetic passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sincere worship or devoted, unself-interested conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression نَصَاحَةٌ contrasted with seeking gain or traffic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sincere, honest, or faithful advice or counsel; also sincere conduct or benevolent concern for another's good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun closely related to نُصْحٌ but retained under its own lexical headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pure or sincere of heart, without deceit, dishonesty, insincerity, or dissimulation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression describing inward sincerity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sewer, needle-worker, or tailor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized occupational use of the active-participial form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pure, clear, fine, or thin white honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed descriptive expression for clarified or unadulterated honey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rains succeeding one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural descriptive use applied to successive rains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A needle used for sewing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the implement, with a feminine variant also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shirt that has been torn and sewn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of a garment repaired by sewing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land abundantly watered by rain, with its herbage densely and closely joined.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive-participial description of land whose vegetation has been brought together by abundant rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Well sewn; also a repaired or patched place in a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The latter use denotes the place of sewing or patching rather than the whole garment.
